BEGIN

PROCEDURE PORTS IS
V_RG_ID RECORDGROUP;
V_STR VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN

 -------------------------------------
 V_RG_ID := FIND_GROUP('GROUP_TYPE5');
 IF ID_NULL (V_RG_ID) THEN

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF :START_DT IS NOT NULL AND :END_DT IS NOT NULL THEN

 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_LIC_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_LIC_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_LIC_NBR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'START_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'END_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_INSPTR_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_INSPTR_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_GROUP_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_GROUP_ID);
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:BRKR_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_IMPR_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_IMPR_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_GRP_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GRP_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_INSPTR_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:INSPTR_NAME);
 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS ,V_REPORT_FILE, SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 
 else
 MESSAGE (' لا توجد سجلا ت تحقق المطلوب ');
 MESSAGE (' لا توجد سجلا ت تحقق المطلوب ');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 end if; 

END ;

PROCEDURE load_list IS
